reviews.author: Stephanie M…
reviews.body: She did such an amazing job!! I’ve never felt more satisfied getting my nails done. From the beginning, she was extremely patient with helping me pick the perfect color and made me feel comfortable through the whole experience. Highly recommend.

reviews.body: Gabby is wonderful, so calming and knowledgable.

reviews.author: Phobe B…
reviews.body: I have had a back facial, microneedling, a signature facial, plus a manicure and pedicure with Gabby, and honestly, I am always impressed by how much care and love she puts into what she does. Every service has been amazing, and I always leave feeling happy and taken care of. She also explains everything so well and makes you feel super comfortable. Definitely a regular here!!
